    Selecting a site highlights all of its fans with usable reported direction, beamwidth and frequency. Click a fan or use the bearing buttons to emphasize one sector; colors repeat after three bearings. For visualization only, each fan is drawn at 5/12 of its original calculated radius; the full estimate is shown in the selected-sector details. Width uses the widest reported beamwidth, enlarged to at least 15° for visibility. TELUS use of an individual Bell site is unverified.

    3GPP TR 38.901 · UMa

    Assumed BS 25 m, UE 1.5 m, receiver gain 0 dBi and no extra loss. Lowest reported TX frequency per bearing. Five twelfths of the calculated boresight radius is drawn across each fan. No site-specific building or terrain modelling, fading margin, interference or antenna-pattern loss. Not RSRP or measured coverage. Model range: 10 m–5 km.
